description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for handling unknown pipeline functions. It includes methods for creating, serializing, and deserializing the exception, and references external classes and interfaces related to exceptions, JSON handling, and HTTP status codes.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception for unknown placeholder functions, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing PlaceholderException.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing instances of PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception with a default message based on the provided function expression.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current exception's data.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated Ditto headers.
